whoItsFor: Developers and teams who want to turn a person's messages, documents, interviews, or public material into a reusable Agent Skill. It fits people preserving a colleague's know-how, modeling a mentor or relative's way of communicating, or building a source-grounded profile of a public figure.
useCases: Preserve a departing colleague's workflows, judgment, and technical standards as an agent skill
Build a Person Profile of a mentor, teammate, or family member from their chat history and documents
Create a source-grounded profile of a public figure or author to ask how they might answer a question
